extras: Desktop only. External file access is disabled by default and requires manual enabling.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that turns the filename in a note's header bar into a clickable, editable breadcrumb of its full vault path — like the address bar in the Dolphin file manager.
problem: Users often struggle to navigate or reference notes by their full file path without leaving the note view.
summary: Lure transforms the note header into an editable, clickable breadcrumb displaying the full vault path, mimicking a file manager address bar.
